activities.name: Al-Balad Historical Quarter Walking Tour
activities.description: You will wander through a labyrinth of coral-stone merchant houses dating back to the 7th century, marvelling at the intricately carved wooden Roshan balconies. Led by a local historian, this route uncovers hidden courtyards, ancient spice souks, and active community mosques. It is an immersive journey into the architectural soul of old Hijazi maritime commerce.
activities.duration_note: Modest dress covering shoulders and knees is strictly required for all participants.

activities.name: Seven Sisters Reef Scuba Diving Excursion
activities.description: You will boat out to a legendary collection of pristine coral pinnacles in the open Red Sea to dive alongside hammerhead sharks, manta rays, and brilliant soft corals. This deep-water drift dive offers underwater visibility often exceeding 40 metres through untouched marine ecosystems. It is a world-class playground for experienced open-water divers seeking dramatic drop-offs.
activities.duration_note: Advanced PADI Open Water certification or equivalent is mandatory; seasonal hammerhead sightings peak from January to April.

activities.name: Traditional Hijazi Seafood Feast at Al-Anbariyah
activities.description: You will select fresh Red Sea catch directly from the ice beds, including local Najil (saddleback grouper), to be seasoned with traditional Hijazi spices and deep-fried or baked in clay ovens. Sitting on low floor cushions, you will pair the fish with fragrant Sayadiyah rice, spicy tamarind sauce, and warm flatbreads. It is an authentic, hands-on culinary rite of passage for seafood lovers.
activities.duration_note: Features separate family and single dining sections; highly casual, hands-on eating style.

activities.name: Sindalah Island Luxury Eco-Sailing Experience
activities.description: You will step aboard a high-end catamaran to glide past the ultra-luxury, newly opened shores of Sindalah Island, stopping to snorkel over isolated patch reefs. The tour includes guided underwater photography and a gourmet zero-waste lunch prepared by an onboard chef using regional ingredients. It balances pristine maritime wilderness with cutting-edge sustainable luxury tourism.
activities.location: Sindalah Island, Red Sea Global Hub
activities.duration_note: Advance booking of 48 hours required for security permits; alcohol available at select licensed resort bars on the island under 2026 regulations.

activities.name: Yam Beach Kite Surfing Masterclass
activities.description: You will harness the consistent, unyielding coastal winds of the western coastline during a private, one-on-one professional kite surfing tutorial on a protected turquoise lagoon. Your instructor will guide you from basic canopy control to carving open water waves and catching air. The calm, shallow waters make it an ideal environment for rapidly building confidence on the board.
activities.duration_note: Requires moderate physical fitness and confident swimming abilities; all specialized gear provided.

activities.name: Rooftop Mocktail Lounge Experience at Sky Lounge
activities.description: You will look out over the glittering Jeddah Corniche and the floodlit King Fahd's Fountain while lounging on plush terraces listening to curated ambient electronic sets from regional DJs. Sip complex, botanically infused artisanal mocktails crafted with local pomegranate, mint, and cold-pressed citrus. It epitomises the energetic, upscale coastal lifestyle that defines modern Jeddah after dark.
activities.duration_note: Smart-casual dress code enforced; no public alcohol consumption permitted here; reservations essential for prime fountain views.

activities.name: Jeddah Corniche Sunset Electric Bicycle Tour
activities.description: You will cruise effortlessly along a 30-kilometre coastal promenade on a high-end electric bike, passing bold modernist open-air sculptures by Joan Miró and Henry Moore. Feel the cool evening breeze kick in as the sun dips below the Red Sea horizon and the city lights flicker to life. It is a refreshing, active way to experience local family life, street performers, and monumental public art.
activities.duration_note: Bike paths are fully flat and segregated from vehicle traffic; suitable for all fitness levels.

activities.name: Mangrove Forest Kayaking Expedition
activities.description: You will paddle a sea kayak through the silent, winding saltwater channels of the Thuwal marine sanctuary, observing a thriving ecosystem tucked along the desert's edge. Spot nesting coastal birds, migrating flamingos, and juvenile marine life darting through the complex root systems below your boat. It highlights an unexpected, lush ecological side of Saudi Arabia's coastal topography.
activities.duration_note: Best booked during early morning hours to avoid midday heat and maximize wildlife sightings.

activities.name: At-Turaif UNESCO World Heritage Site Tour
activities.description: You will walk through the birth-site of the first Saudi state, exploring beautifully restored Najdi mud-brick palaces, defensive towers, and historic treasuries. Enhanced with immersive digital galleries, this outdoor museum traces the origins of Arabian desert architecture and royal history. At night, the entire mud city is beautifully illuminated, reflecting off the adjacent Wadi Hanifa.
activities.duration_note: Requires extensive walking on paved stone paths; evening visits are highly recommended for cooler weather and light shows.

activities.name: Edge of the World 4x4 Desert Expedition
activities.description: You will travel off-road through rugged desert tracks to stand atop the sheer, 300-metre cliffs of the Tuwaiq Escarpment, looking out over an endless ancient ocean bed. Peer down at old camel caravan trails cutting through the plains far below while catching a dramatic desert sunset. The vast, uninterrupted geological horizons make it a surreal, photo-rich escape from the capital.
activities.duration_note: Sturdy hiking boots required; paths near the cliff edge lack guardrails, demanding caution.

activities.name: Najd Village Authentic Culinary Feast
activities.description: You will gather in an authentic, fortress-like Najdi mud house to eat classic Central Arabian dishes like Kabsa (spiced meat and rice) and Jareesh (crushed savory wheat porridge). Sitting cross-legged on traditional patterned carpets, you will experience authentic communal hospitality complete with rich Arabic coffee and sticky dates. It is an unmatched introduction to the rich comfort foods of the desert.
activities.location: Najd Village Restaurant, Takhassusi St, Riyadh
activities.duration_note: Communal floor seating is the standard format; private family rooms are available upon request.

activities.name: Ain Heet Cave Karst Exploration
activities.description: You will descend deep into a limestone mountain fissure to discover a hidden subterranean lake filled with clear, mineral-rich green waters. Scramble over limestone boulders down into the cool cave interior, where the desert sun casts surreal sunbeams onto the hidden water pool. It is an adventurous, geological trek into a fascinating desert karst phenomenon.
activities.duration_note: The descent is steep, loose, and slippery; excellent ankle-supporting footwear is an absolute necessity.

activities.name: High-End Licensed Evening Dining at Il Baretto
activities.description: You will immerse yourself in the sophisticated, high-energy nighttime scene of the financial district, enjoying live jazz or upscale ambient soundtracks alongside world-class Italian fare. Under the 2026 regulations, you can pair your meal with curated fine wines and classic cocktails served within a stunningly designed interior. It represents the vanguard of Riyadh’s cosmopolitan, globally integrated night culture.
activities.duration_note: Strictly adults-only in licensed bar zones; chic evening attire is mandatory and advance reservations are vital.

activities.name: Sky Bridge Observation Deck Panorama
activities.description: You will take a high-speed elevator up to the 99th floor of the iconic Kingdom Centre to walk across a 56-metre glass skybridge suspended high above the city skyline. Look down upon the converging neon thoroughfares of Olaya and King Fahd roads far below you. It provides an unmatched visual perspective of Riyadh's rapid architectural leap from desert outpost to global metropolis.
activities.duration_note: Best visited clear after dark to see the city fully illuminated; entirely family-friendly.

activities.name: Ushaiqer Heritage Village Living History Tour
activities.description: You will step back in time inside a walled oasis town, walking through a living maze of 400-year-old mud houses, ancient wooden doors, and community granaries. Meet local residents who still maintain these traditional ancestral homes and explore a massive private museum of desert artifacts. It offers a wonderfully peaceful, authentic glimpse into old Najdi farming life away from city buzz.
activities.duration_note: Located roughly a 90-minute drive from Riyadh; local traditional lunch can be added on-site.

activities.name: Al Faisaliah Spa Luxury Wellness Ritual
activities.description: You will escape the urban rush inside a lavish, Swarovski crystal-lit sanctuary to indulge in a traditional hot stone massage infused with local date extracts and pure oud oil. Unwind in private mosaic-tiled steam rooms, hydrotherapy pools, and plush relaxation relaxation pods designed to reset your body. It is the ultimate high-end pampering experience reflecting modern Riyadh’s elite wellness scene.
activities.duration_note: Facilities are strictly gender-segregated with dedicated operational hours; booking ahead is required.

activities.name: Hegra Nabataean Tombs Guided Exploration
activities.description: You will board an open-air vintage Land Rover to explore Saudi Arabia's premier UNESCO site, home to over 100 monumental tombs carved directly into freestanding sandstone outcrops. Your personal rawi (storyteller) will decipher ancient Nabataean inscriptions and guide you inside the iconic, monolithic Tomb of Lihyan Son of Kuza. It is a stunning archaeological mirror to Jordan’s Petra, set in a vast desert landscape.
activities.duration_note: Advance online ticket booking is mandatory; touch or entry inside specific tomb interiors is strictly restricted for preservation.

activities.name: Madakhel Canyon Desert Ridge Trek
activities.description: You will hike through narrow, soaring sandstone canyons on a challenging foot trek led by a wilderness guide, scrambling over rock bridges and soft sand dunes. Learn survival skills of the ancient nomads while observing unique wind-carved rock formations hidden away from standard tourist tracks. The deep silence and towering vertical rock walls create an unforgettable desert hiking experience.
activities.duration_note: Requires high physical stamina; operating seasonally from October through April due to extreme summer heat.

activities.name: Citrus & Date Tasting in the Ancient Oasis Farm
activities.description: You will walk under the shade of two million date palms to pick and sample sweet Barni dates and fragrant Jafari oranges directly from an organic heritage farm. Sip cardamom-spiced tea brewed over an open wood fire while local farmers explain the ancient falaj (gravity-fed canal) irrigation systems that have kept this valley alive for millennia. It is an earthy, hyper-local agro-tourism dining experience.
activities.duration_note: Best experienced during the winter harvest season (December to February); dress for dusty farm paths.

activities.name: Gharameel Desert Stargazing & Bedouin Dinner
activities.description: You will escape all light pollution to sit amidst the dark, towering stone pillars of Gharameel while an expert astronomer uses laser pointers to decode constellations in the dark night sky. Enjoy an authentic Bedouin dinner cooked slowly under the desert sand while listening to traditional stories. The clarity of the Milky Way arching over these ancient stone spires is a mesmerizing visual experience.
activities.location: Gharameel Dark Sky Site, north of AlUla
activities.duration_note: Desert temperatures drop significantly at night during winter; warm layers are highly recommended.

activities.name: Trojena Alpine Mountain Hiking Trail
activities.description: You will hike through the stark, high-altitude peaks of Trojena along newly constructed eco-trails that showcase the high-altitude wilderness of the Sarawat mountains. Peer out across dramatic valleys where futuristic, sustainable alpine architecture is being carved into the rock face. It is a glimpse into the future of mountain tourism, offering fresh mountain air and striking high-altitude geology.
activities.duration_note: Temperatures here are significantly colder than the rest of the country; winter snow can occur.

activities.name: Upmarket Evening Mixology at Habitas Banyan Tree
activities.description: You will gather around sunken fire pits embedded in a breathtaking canyon floor, enjoying curated ambient music and high-end hospitality under the stars. Under the 2026 guidelines, these premium international desert resorts offer licensed selections of fine wines and masterfully prepared lower-ABV drinks. It is an exclusive, stunningly scenic night out tailored for discerning global travellers.
activities.duration_note: Strictly adults-only in licensed areas; advance resort entry gates require a confirmed table booking.

activities.name: Elephant Rock Sunset Viewpoint Lounge
activities.description: You will relax in comfortable sunken seating pits carved directly into the desert floor, facing a massive, three-story natural sandstone arch that looks exactly like a giant elephant. Watch the rock change from deep gold to vibrant purple as the sun sets, while enjoying hot mint tea and fine shisha. It is one of the country's most famous and relaxing outdoor evening social spots.
activities.duration_note: No entry fee required, but minimum spends apply at the sunken lounge seating areas during peak weekend hours.

activities.name: Habitas Thuraya Wellness Sanctuary Yoga
activities.description: You will center your mind and body during a sunrise yoga session on an elevated wooden platform completely enclosed by soaring, thousands-of-years-old red sandstone cliffs. Followed by a sound-healing session using traditional Tibetan singing bowls and local frankincense aromatherapy, this experience is designed to restore balance. It is an internationally acclaimed wellness experience set in deep desert tranquility.
activities.duration_note: Pre-booking is highly recommended as class sizes are kept small to preserve the quiet atmosphere.

activities.name: Rijal Almaa Gingerbread Cultural Village Tour
activities.description: You will explore a stunning 900-year-old alpine village of multi-story fortresses constructed from dark local stone and accented with white quartz patterns and vibrant, hand-painted 'Qatt Al-Asiri' wall art. Walk through the steep stone staircases, ancient community courtrooms, and terraced spice gardens. It offers a fascinating look into the highly distinct, resilient mountain cultures of the southwest.
activities.duration_note: Features steep stone stairs and uneven steps; comfortable walking shoes with good grip are required.

activities.name: Mount Al-Soudah Paragliding Adventure
activities.description: You will strap in for a thrilling tandem paragliding flight off the highest peak in Saudi Arabia, launching from a juniper-covered ridge nearly 3,000 metres above sea level. Glide high above dramatic mountain valleys, mist-shrouded peaks, and traditional stone villages terraced into the mountainsides. It is an adrenaline-packed flight offering a fresh, green, and high-altitude look at the country.
activities.duration_note: Strictly subject to wind conditions; weight limits between 45kg and 110kg apply for safety reasons.

activities.name: Asiri Haneeth Communal Dining Experience
activities.description: You will taste Haneeth, an incredibly tender local lamb dish seasoned with simple spices and slow-cooked for hours on fresh markh wood inside a sealed underground tannour clay oven. The meat is served over a large bed of saffron rice, allowing the smoky, wood-infused flavors to shine. It is a legendary culinary tradition that defines highland generosity and traditional cooking techniques.
activities.duration_note: Portions are very large and explicitly intended for group or family sharing.

activities.name: Wadi Lajab Slit Canyon Water Trek
activities.description: You will hike, wade, and swim through a breathtakingly narrow, 300-metre-deep slit canyon where freshwater springs feed a continuous stream lined with hanging moss gardens and wild orchids. Scramble over smooth boulders and cool off in refreshing, shaded rock pools deep within the mountain fissure. It is a stunning, hidden subtropical paradise that offers an adventurous contrast to the desert plains.
activities.duration_note: Flash flood hazards can occur during rainy spells; utilizing a licensed local mountain guide is mandatory.

activities.name: Farasan Marine Sanctuary Mangrove Boat Tour
activities.description: You will board a local fisherman’s skiff to explore the pristine coral reefs and dense mangrove channels of the remote Farasan Islands archipelago. Swim alongside sea turtles and spot rare birds like the white-eyed gull in these protected waters. It is an untouched, low-key eco-tourism destination perfect for travellers seeking raw nature away from major resort developments.
activities.duration_note: Requires taking the morning ferry from Jazan port; passport details must be provided to coast guard authorities.

activities.name: Highland Fog Cafe Evening at The Art Street
activities.description: You will stroll along a vibrant pedestrian avenue covered by purple-flowering jacaranda trees, stopping at an artisanal cafe to sip local mountain coffee while mountain fog rolls through the streets. Enjoy live acoustic performances by local musicians and view outdoor art installations by regional Asiri painters. It is a charming, cool evening social scene that takes advantage of the region’s unique alpine climate.
activities.duration_note: Public spaces here are completely dry; temperatures can get chilly, so bringing a light jacket or sweater is advised.

activities.name: Green Mountain Cable Car Ridge View
activities.description: You will ride a panoramic cable car up to the peak of Jabal Thera (Green Mountain), taking in expansive views of Abha's terraced agricultural valleys and mountain roads. Watch the city lights come to life as the summit building glows with brilliant emerald green lights against the night sky. It is a relaxing, family-friendly sightseeing ride providing a great layout of the highland topography.
activities.duration_note: Cable cars may pause operations during heavy low-lying cloud cover or high mountain winds.

activities.name: Khoban Mountain Honey & Wellness Tour
activities.description: You will travel high into the steep cloud forests of Jazan to visit a multi-generational mountain apiary, learning how rare, high-value sidr honey is harvested from cliffside hives. End your tour with a traditional therapeutic wellness tasting paired with warm organic local wheat cakes and fresh mountain ghee. It is an earthy, revitalizing experience rooted in ancient southwestern holistic traditions.
activities.duration_note: Requires navigating steep, winding mountain roads; not recommended for travellers prone to severe motion sickness.

activities.name: Al-Qarah Caves Limestone Labyrinth Exploration
activities.description: You will wander through a fascinating network of tall, narrow limestone fissures carved into a massive freestanding plateau over millions of years by wind and water water erosion. The interior caves feature a unique natural microclimate that remains remarkably cool throughout the year, even during intense summer heat. It is a structurally stunning, naturally air-conditioned geological trek right in the heart of the oasis.
activities.duration_note: Fully wheelchair accessible along the main paths; well-lit with installed eco-friendly LED trail systems.

activities.name: Half Moon Bay Scuba & Artificial Reef Dive
activities.description: You will dive into the warm, shallow waters of the Arabian Gulf to explore a creative artificial reef project constructed from intentionally sunken cars, structures, and marine habitats. Swim among local hammour, batfish, and crabs that have claimed these structures as their home. The calm, current-free coastal conditions make it the premier training site for diving enthusiasts in the Eastern Province.
activities.duration_note: All dive equipment rentals are readily available on-site; ideal for entry-level or rusty divers.

activities.name: Authentic Al-Ahsa Rice & Khalas Date Culinary Lunch
activities.description: You will sit down to sample legendary Hesawi Rice, an incredibly rich, local red-grain rice cooked with warm spices and paired with tender lamb. Follow your main course with a curated tasting of premium Khalas dates, locally pressed date molasses, and hot mint tea. It is a hearty culinary exploration celebrating the ancient agricultural bounty of the world's largest self-contained desert oasis.
activities.duration_note: Hesawi rice is exceptionally filling; come with a hearty appetite; family-friendly seating format.

activities.name: Empty Quarter Starry Desert Expedition
activities.description: You will venture off-road into the world's largest continuous sand desert, navigating massive, 200-metre-tall wind-sculpted star dunes in a fully equipped 4x4 vehicle. Camp in comfortable wilderness tents under an incredibly clear night sky, listening to traditional stories around a crackling campfire. It is an epic, remote desert adventure into one of the most wild landscapes on the planet.
activities.location: Rub al-Khali Entry Zone, south of Hofuf
activities.duration_note: Requires excellent physical health; fully inclusive of expert desert guides, safety satellite comms, and all meals.

activities.name: Ithra Cultural Landmark Guided Architecture Architecture Tour
activities.description: You will tour a spectacular, state-of-the-art cultural mega-complex designed by Snøhetta, featuring futuristic, smooth chrome buildings that look like giant desert pebbles. Explore world-class museums, a massive multi-story library, a theater, and cutting-edge interactive digital art exhibitions. It represents the bold pinnacle of modern cultural investment and architectural engineering in the Eastern Province.
activities.location: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), Al-Khobar
activities.duration_note: Highly family-friendly; booking specific theater or specialty exhibition tickets online in advance is advised.

activities.name: Upmarket Marina Dining & Lounge at Grand Hyatt
activities.description: You will spend an upscale evening overlooking a stylish marina along the Arabian Gulf, enjoying refined international fusion dining and background lounge music. Under the 2026 regulations, these select five-star coastal properties offer licensed bars serving high-end wine and craft beer. It is a sleek, cosmopolitan waterfront social setting popular with business travellers and international expats.
activities.duration_note: Strictly adults-only within licensed bar venues; elegant evening dress code is enforced.

activities.name: Souq Al-Qaysariyah Traditional Merchant Walk
activities.description: You will walk down the wide, historic clay-covered avenues of one of the oldest operational markets in the Arabian Peninsula, breathing in rich aromas of cardamom, agarwood incense, and freshly ground spices. Browse through historic open-front stalls to check out handcrafted leather sandals, brass coffee pots, and high-quality local textiles. It is an authentic, non-touristy shopping walk through regional living heritage.
activities.duration_note: The market closes down for afternoon prayers and during mid-day heat; best visited late afternoon or evening.

activities.name: Traditional Hammam & Date-Scrub Wellness Treatment
activities.description: You will relax inside a beautifully tiled traditional bathhouse to undergo an exfoliating body scrub that utilizes an organic paste made from local dates, brown sugar, and rich argan oil. Follow your scrub with a deeply relaxing steam session and a massage infused with warm cedarwood essential oils. It is a soothing, regionally inspired wellness experience designed to smooth and revitalize your skin.
activities.duration_note: Facilities are strictly gender-segregated with separate operational wings for male and female guests.
